model: skeleton-v3 (Walk) + v3 custom (Attack, Dash, Skill, Hurt)
size: 128 import, clips 172/176 px, padded to 192 (lowest pixel on row 150)

clips.Walk: animate_character skeleton-v3 template walking-6-frames, east + west + north + south (3 gens each; north/south were needed by check:streetwear-walk)
clips.Attack: animate_character v3 custom 'nodachi wide horizontal slash, sword stays in hand', 8 frames + reference, east (4) and west re-roll (4, first west roll swung the blade behind him)
clips.Dash: v3 custom 'dashing forward, nodachi held low behind', east + west (4 each)
clips.Skill: v3 custom 'plants the nodachi into the ground, calls a tidal surge, pulls it free', east (4) and west re-roll (4)
clips.Hurt: v3 custom 'flinching back from a heavy hit', 6 frames + reference, east + west (3 each)
clips.Idle: art engine breathing-idle (0 gens), rig art-src/rigs/ironclad-kabuto.json, 4 frames 400/250/400/250 (the clip-holds check pins 1300 ms), head settles one extra px on the low frame

params.tideTrail: Attack frames 3-7 carry a tide-blue streak behind the blade tip (drawn by script, tip = farthest blade-light pixel above the legs)
params.discarded: Attack east cross-punch template test (3 gens, lost the sword); first Attack west and Skill west rolls (8 gens, wrong-way swing / last frame turned)

critique.notes: M3 hero 1; frames padded to 192, feet row 150; raw PixelLab output kept in m3-test/ (outside raw/)
